integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] The opening battlefield scene of a practical opera performance with ONE real adult actor, Draco, entering the existing empty stage from screen RIGHT. This is a real indoor theatre with physical painted scenery, not an outdoor desert, game render or cartoon. No moon, castle, blue parapet, balcony, daylight exterior, new wall or second curtain. Do NOT reopen or move the gathered curtain, replace the rocks or move the painted clouds. The same set remains fixed from start to finish, without scenic morphing. No new lighting cue or bright aperture.

DRACO is the sole young BLUE man in Picture2: same clean-shaven oval face, prominent straight nose, short dark curly hair, lean adult proportions, fair natural skin, high-collared textured cobalt/steel-blue tunic, plain worn SILVER breastplate with its simple raised edges, dark NAVY BLUE long cloak attached at shoulders, blue fitted trousers and worn brown leather knee boots. His one sword stays SHEATHED at his left hip, same scabbard and hilt; it moves with his belt, never drawn or duplicated. Two empty natural hands, five fingers each. His dark blue cloak stays attached and weighted, trailing a small natural distance behind his legs. Use real skin pores, curly hair strands, matte wool, stitched textile, worn leather and subdued practical silver metal, not glossy CGI or costume changing. No flowers, bouquet, crown or new object.
